health.note: Expected: HTTP 200 with {"status":"ok"} when PostgreSQL is reachable. A database failure returns 503.
health.label: REQUEST / CURL

create.note: Set PROJECT_KEY from your project and REPORTER_TOKEN to a random 16–64 character URL-safe test identity. Allow http://localhost:5173. Expected: HTTP 201 with ticket_code, status, and created_at.
create.label: REQUEST / CURL

embed.note: Replace the host and project key. Add your application origin to the project allowlist. Press Alt+B after the script loads.
embed.label: INTEGRATION / HTML
